chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, all together from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Burayd ibn Mu'awiyah, from Abu Ja'far (عليه السلام), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم) said: Allah, Mighty and Majestic, does not look upon a friend devoted to Him who strives himself in obedience to his Imam and in sincere counsel, except that he will be with us in the Highest Company.

key_terms.إِمَامِهِ: his Imam, the divinely appointed leader to whom obedience is due
key_terms.الرَّفِيقِ الْأَعْلَى: the Highest Company, the exalted companionship in the Hereafter
key_terms.الطَّاعَةِ: obedience and compliance with rightful authority
key_terms.وَلِيٍّ: a devoted friend and loyal servant of Allah

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for obeying the Imam and offering sincere nasiha in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that sincere striving in obedience to one's Imam and offering true nasiha are marks of Allah’s devoted servant. Such loyalty and effort are linked to nearness to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and the highest rank in the Hereafter.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father and Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, altogether from Hammad Bin Isa, from Hareyz, from Bureyd Bin Muawiya,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic continues Looking to a friend of His<sup>azwj</sup>, who strived himself with obedience to his Imam<sup>asws</sup> and the advice until he will find himself with us<sup>asws</sup> among the lofty friends’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father and Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad all together from Hammad ibn ‘Isa from Hariz from Burayd ibn Mu‘awiya from abu Ja‘far (a.s.) who has said the following. “

the Messenger of Allah has said, ‘Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most gracious, would not look to a friend of His who would strive and pressure his soul in obedience to his Imam and wishing well for him but that he will be with us in the high position in paradise.”
